title: Tracing Year (Figure with CDs)
description: Mixed-media collage depicting a hand-drawn figure with outstretched arms against a vivid blue-and-green background. Four compact discs are affixed around the torso, alongside heart motifs, a lace-doily snowflake, and a small snowman sketch; handwritten text reads 'tracing' and 'year' at lower left.
composition: central figure surrounded by scattered CDs
